poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Take 10 damage per tick. More Poison extends the duration.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Heal 10 per tick. More Regeneration extends the duration.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: Absorbs direct damage, but not damage over time. Keeps the higher amount instead of stacking.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Cancels the enemy’s current spell and remaining Channel copies.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.description: +50% direct damage, healing and Ward. Does not boost Trigger effects.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Fire casts grant 1 Heat. Spend 5 to make your next non-Instant spell 1T and Empowered.

oath.name: Oath
oath.description: Meet the condition with your following spells to earn the reward. Only one Oath at a time.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Each charge adds 1T to your next non-Instant cast.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove debuff types: Poison, Slow, Trap or Curse.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Resolve the spell’s effects again without another cast.

consume.name: Consume
consume.description: Spend the named effect for the listed benefit.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Link up to 3 adjacent matching spells. Each extra copy boosts every spell in the group.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Hold only one copy. Matching copies can still upgrade it.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: One pass through your spells, then a 1T reshuffle.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Take 10 damage per stack each Cycle. Lasts until cleansed.

attunement.name: Attunement
attunement.description: Your two most common domains are attuned, unlocking their marked effects. Ties favor older cards.

instant.name: Instant
instant.description: Resolves before other effects that tick.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Each completed spell spends a charge and deals 10 damage to you.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Each charge blocks one damage event. Cannot block Health costs.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Repeat the spell’s effects at the listed strength, without another cast.

critical.name: Critical
critical.description: Deals 150% direct damage when its condition is met.

cultivate.name: Cultivate
cultivate.description: Spend the named effect to gain the listed reward.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Give the effect to the enemy.

summon.name: Summon
summon.description: Summon or strengthen an Imp that absorbs direct damage. Empowered Imps attack after your casts.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.description: Breaks after casting and Echoing. Returns next duel.

unholy.name: Unholy
unholy.description: Your healing deals damage to the enemy instead.

tide.name: Tide
tide.description: Water casts grant 1 Tide. Spend 3 to Echo your next non-Instant spell at 50% strength.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Arms after its first cast. Then activates when its condition is met, once per tick.

retrigger.name: Retrigger
retrigger.description: Repeat your last Armed Trigger this Cycle. Cannot start another Trigger chain.

awaken.name: Awaken
awaken.description: Transforms for the rest of the duel when its condition is met.
